# STDP_Memristive_Synapse

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A memristor-based synaptic element that implements spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP) for local, unsupervised learning in neuromorphic circuits. Provides a hardware-native mechanism for in-network learning and adaptation, critical for energy-efficient iNEST implementations.
